correctness.rationale: Induced-degree<=1 defines faces on precisely 18 vertices. Independently enumerated all 262143 nonempty masks, finding 22692 faces; independently reconstructed 11343 disjoint pivot matching pairs in the published order, six critical cells (one 0-cell, one 5-cell mask 74386 and four 7-cells 37291,37801,69995,70505), and directed Hasse graph with all 132988 covering incidences topologically sorted (acyclic). The dual mod-two fifth cocycle reconstructed from matching recursion has precisely four support masks 73875,73878,74386,75922, common five-vertex intersection 73874, and every pair union at most seven vertices. The cocycle condition holds on every degree-six face; by the cup-3 cochain formula each degree-seven coefficient requires two supporting 5-faces whose union includes all eight vertices, impossible here. Thus Sq2=0. The Morse CW model has one 5-cell and four 7-cells with possible attaching maps in pi6(S5)=Z/2; nontrivial suspended Hopf class is detected by Sq2, forcing all four trivial and the asserted integral wedge. This concerns exactly n=9, not extrapolation.
